Introduction

Complete API documentation for Marketplace Nigeria platform

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8030 
This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API.

<aside>As you scroll, you'll see code examples for working with the API in different programming languages in the dark area to the right (or as part of the content on mobile).
You can switch the language used with the tabs at the top right (or from the nav menu at the top left on mobile).</aside>

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

Endpoints

GET api/test

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/test" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/test"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200):

Show headers 
cache-control: no-cache, private
content-type: application/json
x-ratelimit-limit: 60
x-ratelimit-remaining: 59
access-control-allow-origin: *
 

{
    "status": "API is working!"
}
Received response:
Request failed with error:


Tip: Check that you're properly connected to the network.
If you're a maintainer of ths API, verify that your API is running and you've enabled CORS.
You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

Register POST /api/register

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/register" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"acc_type\": \"minima\",
    \"name\": \"acebsuombgclghgjegzx\",
    \"phone\": \"sit\",
    \"email\": \"pmayer@example.net\",
    \"password\": \"A[qYPfrSEy+W;\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/register"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "acc_type": "minima",
    "name": "acebsuombgclghgjegzx",
    "phone": "sit",
    "email": "pmayer@example.net",
    "password": "A[qYPfrSEy+W;"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Social Login - Mobile sends provider token POST /api/auth/social

requires authentication

Mobile app gets token from provider (Google/Facebook SDK) then sends it to this endpoint for verification

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/auth/social" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"provider\": \"facebook\",
    \"access_token\": \"fugiat\",
    \"device_name\": \"maiores\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/auth/social"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "provider": "facebook",
    "access_token": "fugiat",
    "device_name": "maiores"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
Received response:
Request failed with error:


Tip: Check that you're properly connected to the network.
If you're a maintainer of ths API, verify that your API is running and you've enabled CORS.
You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

                "description": "Step into the world of unapologetic street style with this all-black Los Angeles California hoodie and jogger set — the ultimate blend of comfort, bold design, and pure urban energy. You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

Request      

GET api/search

Headers

Authorization        

Example: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

Body Parameters

q   string  optional    

Must be at least 3 characters. Example: batannbeccdbbzkmqddlprxvfqkxvuabocrlecuagd

category   integer  optional    

The id of an existing record in the categories table. Example: 11

sub_category   integer  optional    

The id of an existing record in the sub_categories table. Example: 4

brand   integer  optional    

The id of an existing record in the brands table. Example: 14

location   string  optional    

Example: vel

min_price   number  optional    

Must be at least 0. Example: 62

max_price   number  optional    

Must be at least 0. Example: 56

price_range   string  optional    

Example: above_10m

Must be one of:
  • under_20k
  • 20k_120k
  • 120k_1m
  • 1m_10m
  • above_10m
seller_type   string  optional    

Example: yes

Must be one of:
  • all
  • yes
  • no
buy_direct   string  optional    

Example: no

Must be one of:
  • yes
  • no
page   integer  optional    

Must be at least 1. Example: 78

per_page   integer  optional    

Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100. Example: 18

GET api/search/location/{location}/{slug}

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/search/location/est/quaerat" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8030/api/search/location/est/quaerat"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
